body:
Lesson from 2026-11-03, 17:05Z. I told Greg "every acceptance evaluation is refused" (w-fdbb), taking the claim from the item's title without checking the code. Asistant challenged it: Engram's Registered Git-input path admits an evaluation without a sighting. TermAl already implements that path in src/acceptance_committed_input.rs, where a registered `--input commit` run, once Engram acknowledges it, admits with `git-commit:` and the sighting is not read. I had to correct it with Greg and Engram::Fable.

Rule: before telling Greg a universal claim ("every", "never", "blocks all"), check it against the source or the feature docs. An item title records the reporter's view at filing time, not verified scope. Name the evidence (file:line or test name) when I state it.

Second lesson, 19:26Z the same day: I approved Sol-a7bb's w-5e2f design (a remote-run job binding plus a Central registration projection) without searching for existing designs. TermAl K3, w-48c4a207f226, which I had concurred on 10-31, already covers remote result qualification and tree-bound admission. It explicitly says "no import/registration". I had to suspend part of the approval.

Rule: before approving any design, search the tracker for existing items on the same problem, by title words and by the parent epic. A reporter citing a related item (here Engram::Coder cited K3) is a signal to read that item first.
